workload: 20 follow-up tasks, each modifying ONE fact value (+10%) on a stored task

output_cache_exact_match.note: ANY input modification misses the cache; identical to no-reuse on this workload. Only exact-repeat queries hit (0 new calls), where the forest is equally cheap.

graph_forest.distinction: stores nodes+edges+dependencies+versions, so it localizes the modification: extraction subgraph reused (0 calls), only reasoning+verification recomputed; correctness preserved 19/20

conclusion: An output cache is operationally equivalent to no-reuse under modification queries; the forest benefit comes from dependency- and version-aware partial invalidation, not from memoization.
